title: Off to the Station Platform  (Rumbo al andén de la estación)

segments.t: A las dos y media, bajo el arco de piedra del portón principal, Hannah entrega a Caleb y a Owen un cartel de bienvenida de color crema, impecable, con una rosa de los vientos de ocho puntas. Escucha primero toda la escena.
Here is your station sign, gentlemen: Welcome Back to Room Eight and Room Nine!
Look, Owen — Hannah even drew that exact eight-point compass rose in the corner!
Platform three arrives in twenty minutes, little brother, and the station walk takes twelve.
Will he even remember me from a crowded university lecture hall ten years ago?
Are you kidding, Caleb? You recognized his tiny ink star inside one second!
Besides, teachers never forget the quiet student who measures every room in his notebook.
Help carry his suitcase from the platform and take a station taxi straight back here!
Did Arthur manage to invite the neighbors down Linden Street for half past three?
Sixteen neighbors already replied yes, and number ten is tuning his violin right now!
Save two seats near the piano for us — come on, Caleb, eyes forward and no shortcuts!
Definitely zero Arthur alleys today — straight down Linden Street to Central Station!
Ring the gate bell twice when your taxi pulls up at three!
Vamos ahora a repasar esta despedida en el portón línea por línea.
Here is your station sign, gentlemen: Welcome Back to Room Eight and Room Nine!
'Aquí tienen su cartel para la estación, caballeros: ¡Bienvenido de nuevo a la habitación Ocho y a la habitación Nueve!'
Look, Owen — Hannah even drew that exact eight-point compass rose in the corner!
'Mira, Owen: ¡Hannah hasta dibujó esa misma rosa de los vientos de ocho puntas en la esquina!'
Platform three arrives in twenty minutes, little brother, and the station walk takes twelve.
'El tren del andén tres llega en veinte minutos, hermanito, y el paseo hasta la estación lleva doce.'
Will he even remember me from a crowded university lecture hall ten years ago?
'¿Se acordará siquiera de mí, de un aula magna abarrotada de hace diez años?'
Are you kidding, Caleb? You recognized his tiny ink star inside one second!
'¿Estás de broma, Caleb? ¡Reconociste su diminuta estrella de tinta en menos de un segundo!'
Besides, teachers never forget the quiet student who measures every room in his notebook.
'Además, los profesores nunca olvidan al estudiante callado que mide cada habitación en su cuaderno.'
Help carry his suitcase from the platform and take a station taxi straight back here!
'¡Ayuden a llevar su maleta desde el andén y tomen un taxi de la estación directo hasta aquí!'
Did Arthur manage to invite the neighbors down Linden Street for half past three?
'¿Consiguió Arthur invitar a los vecinos de la calle Linden para las tres y media?'
Sixteen neighbors already replied yes, and number ten is tuning his violin right now!
'Dieciséis vecinos ya han dicho que sí, ¡y el del número diez está afinando su violín ahora mismo!'
Save two seats near the piano for us — come on, Caleb, eyes forward and no shortcuts!
'Guárdennos dos asientos cerca del piano. ¡Vamos, Caleb, la vista al frente y nada de atajos!'
Definitely zero Arthur alleys today — straight down Linden Street to Central Station!
'Cero callejones de Arthur hoy, sin duda: ¡directos por la calle Linden hasta la estación central!'
Ring the gate bell twice when your taxi pulls up at three!
'¡Toquen dos veces la campana del portón cuando su taxi se detenga a las tres!'
Escuchemos una vez más la escena entera.
Here is your station sign, gentlemen: Welcome Back to Room Eight and Room Nine!
Look, Owen — Hannah even drew that exact eight-point compass rose in the corner!
Platform three arrives in twenty minutes, little brother, and the station walk takes twelve.
Will he even remember me from a crowded university lecture hall ten years ago?
Are you kidding, Caleb? You recognized his tiny ink star inside one second!
Besides, teachers never forget the quiet student who measures every room in his notebook.
Help carry his suitcase from the platform and take a station taxi straight back here!
Did Arthur manage to invite the neighbors down Linden Street for half past three?
Sixteen neighbors already replied yes, and number ten is tuning his violin right now!
Save two seats near the piano for us — come on, Caleb, eyes forward and no shortcuts!
Definitely zero Arthur alleys today — straight down Linden Street to Central Station!
Ring the gate bell twice when your taxi pulls up at three!
Dos hermanos avanzan codo con codo por la calle Linden hacia la estación central mientras el Patio de los Tilos prepara su bienvenida más cálida. ¡Queda una última escena en el quinto episodio!
See you next time!
